calls.title: Catena + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The team discussed the feasibility of edge-based A/B testing for a dynamic toplist tool, addressing concerns about caching inefficiency due to multiple permutations. Low traffic and short cache durations were identified as limitations impacting cache hit rates, yet caching was deemed workable. The GrowthBook visual editor's flexibility allows for live changes without heavy development involvement, enhancing the testing process. AI advancements, particularly with the MCP server, are expected to automate experiment creation and hypothesis generation, catering to customer needs. The team also planned collaborative trials with flexible periods of two to four weeks, emphasizing the impact of a small development team on rollout timelines.
calls.keywords: Visual Editor, Edge Experimentation, Growth Book, AI Integration, CDN Caching, Data Warehouse
